summary: Accept as focused test-only hardening. The exact candidate adds no production fix. Its three Full+MAMBA host-tier tests passed with real D2H/H2D transfers on the assigned MI350X, and the recorded base already passed adjacent unified-cache HiCache tests. The original failure could not be reproduced at the required base because that base already contains generalized host-leaf demotion and MAMBA host-LRU behavior. This does not establish the reported TP4 hybrid-KDA serving fix.

tests.what_was_measured: Recorded-base adjacent unified-cache Full+MAMBA HiCache behavior: 40 passed, 36 skipped.

tests.command: HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-9ec491cc239a/venv/bin/python -m pytest -q <candidate three focused test node ids> -s
tests.what_was_measured: Exact-candidate committed Full+MAMBA backup, device eviction, host discovery, host LRU/locks/accounting, H2D load-back and exact tensor restoration; plus missing-MAMBA and MAMBA-only negative states. 3 passed.

tests.command: temporary review mutation removing MambaComponent's local host-LRU insertion, then run the positive candidate test
tests.what_was_measured: The test still passed because UnifiedTreeCore._demote independently inserts auxiliary host-LRU entries. The mutation was fully reverted before leaving the candidate checkout; this is evidence of redundant enforcement, not a candidate failure.

gpu_execution.evidence: PyTorch 2.11.0+rocm7.2 reported one AMD Instinct MI350X; the candidate fixture used CUDA/HIP pools and compared restored GPU KV, temporal, and convolution tensors exactly.

remaining_counterexamples: No TP4 Ling-3.0-flash or other hybrid-KDA model serving reproduction was run; only one GPU and no qualifying model weights were available.
There is no failing-before at recorded base 358c163250ad3b1f62939b01ce1314a0a31a0365, so the historical production regression and the commit that fixed it remain unidentified.
The candidate is test-only and cannot itself repair an older affected revision.
remaining_limitations: The deterministic tiny Llama fixture was intentionally not used because it cannot qualify MAMBA/KDA architecture or TP4 behavior.
The prepared checkout is shallow/grafted, limiting historical attribution.
No native source changed in the candidate, so a native rebuild was not applicable.
